name: PlushiePet : Your New Best Friend!
source:
Feeling overwhelmed? 

Tired of waking up to dystopian and/or exhausting news stories?

Wish the world would slow down?

Here at PlushiePet Corporation, we've got your back. 

PlushiePet is a wellness and utility companion with 100+ features, and dozens of adorable designs randomly distributed via blind boxes!

Your PlushiePet is uniquely yours! And you are theirs. 

It's an alarm clock. It's a wellness app. It's a 3D printer. It's a geiger counter. And it's the only friend you'll ever need.

[From [url=https://i-choose-paradise.itch.io/plushiepet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
感到不知所措吗？

厌倦了醒来时看到反乌托邦和/或令人筋疲力尽的新闻报道？

希望世界慢下来？

在PlushiePet Corporation，我们为你提供支持。

PlushiePet是一款健康实用的伴侣，拥有100多种功能，以及通过盲盒随机分发的数十种可爱设计！

你的毛绒宠物是独一无二的！而你是他们的。

这是一个闹钟。这是一款健康应用程序。这是一台3D打印机。这是盖革计数器。这是你唯一需要的朋友。

[来自[url=https://i-choose-paradise.itch.io/plushiepet]itch.io[/url]]
